newsitem.title: UK: Ibstock sells brick plants for 53 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Ibstock sells brick plants for 53 mln stg.

text.p: British building materials supplier Ibstock Plc said on Wednesday it had sold five brick manufacturing plants for 53 million stg to Ambion Brick Company Ltd.

Ibstock said Ambion paid 44 million stg on completion and would pay a further 3.0 million in instalments, with interest, over 21 months from completion. A further 6.0 million stg would be paid by Redland Plc under the terms of a deal agreed when Ibstock bought Redland Bricks Ltd.

Ibstock said the brick manufacturing plants had a combined total manufacturing capacity of 174 million bricks per annum and net assets of approximately 50 million stg. The proceeds of the sale would be used to cut borrowings, Ibstock said.
Ibstock said Ambion was a new company formed by Royal Bank Development Capital Ltd, a subsidiary of the Royal Bank of Scotland.
